P1.1.text: IIoT Devices and Services for M2M Networking | Digi International

P1.2.text: Digi IIoT devices, software and services for enterprise, industrial and smart city IoT and M2M applications.

P1.3.text: Empowering businesses with reliable, secure IoT connectivity

P1.4.text: Basically, the Opengear devices paid for themselves in nine months. Once we had equipped all eleven ships with them, we were able to update the network devices remotely and no longer had to hire a service provider. This not only saves money, but also frees up a cabin on board for a paying guest.

P1.5.text: Diogo Almeida, Head of Network, Connectivity & Infrastructure at AIDA Cruises

P1.6.text: The DigiMesh network solution is very easy for us to deploy – and far less expensive than competing solutions.

P1.7.text: Daniel Noiseux, General Manager and Executive Vice President

P1.8.text: Every promise Digi has made, they’ve delivered on – and that’s huge. They have reduced our risk, improved our product, and accelerated our timelines. You can’t ask for much more than that.

P1.10.text: For us, SmartSense was an immediate win.

P1.11.text: Joe Laufenburg, Senior Director of Asset Protection

P1.12.text: With Particle's platform, Jacuzzi® Hot Tubs are connected to the Internet and can notify owners and local dealers when maintenance needs to occur. With increased visibility into the state and location of each tub, Jacuzzi® plans to save millions thanks to IoT-based preventative maintenance.

P1.13.text: Collaborating with the AT&T and NYC DOT teams to plan and deploy this massive rollout was a great experience. It shows the power of partnerships.

P1.14.text: Digi’s solution was flexible enough to take the data and send it real-time to our cloud environment. Digi also showed it could scale up to support our global footprint.

P1.15.text: Ezhil Nanjappan, Otis Elevator Director of IoT and Mobility Solutions

P1.16.text: We tried to create our own FCC-licensed radio product, but it was a big drain on our engineering resources, and we weren’t totally happy with the performance. Digi's robustness was far better than the other alternatives we evaluated.

P1.17.text: Digi hardened rail routers provide fault-tolerant and failsafe communications, both on-board and with remote systems over cellular networks.

P1.18.text: Digi TX64 is the ideal choice for TriMet, because of its durability, performance, and customizability. We love that we can customize the router through Digi Advanced Linux and custom Python apps to integrate it easily with our CAD/AVL, and other vehicle-based systems.

P1.19.text: Evan Yand, Senior Vehicle Systems Engineer

P1.20.text: We are integrating Digi technology into a range of solutions, including smart irrigation systems, to help modern farms deploy remote sensors, cameras, and wireless networks for greater efficiency in the fields.

P1.21.text: Troy Long, Vice President Technology Value Stream

P1.22.text: From edge to cloud, hardware to software, infrastructure to insight, Digi is the engine behind enterprise operations everywhere. Digi unifies its brands, innovations, and global expertise into a single mission: to help the world build smarter, connect securely, and manage confidently.

P1.23.text: Digi XBee Wireless modules for secure device connectivity

P1.24.text: Digi ConnectCore System-on-modules for embedded product design

P1.25.text: Digi X-ON Platform for smart infrastructure built on LoRaWAN®

P1.26.text: Cellular Routers and Endpoints Reliable cellular networking for industrial use

P1.28.text: Opengear Console Servers Out-of-band access for critical infrastructure

P1.30.text: Digi Ventus Managed Connectivity Turnkey cellular connectivity with support

P1.31.text: Opengear Lighthouse Platform Out-of-band network management platform

P1.32.text: Particle Platform Embedded intelligence and wireless communications

P1.33.text: SmartSense Monitoring Real-time condition and compliance monitoring

P1.34.text: Add value to your connectivity solutions with expert services:

P1.36.text: Trusted Solutions to Build Smarter, Connect Faster, and Manage at Scale

P1.37.text: SmartSense delivers remote walk-in cooler monitoring with real-time sensors, instant alerts, and automated compliance reporting to protect food safety
